description: This short circular walk visits a photogenic, natural stone arch in Portknockie on the Moray Firth. There is car park next to the rock, just north of the village. From here you can pick up a circular footpath where you can enjoy fine views of the impressive Bow Fiddle Rock and Cullen Bay. On the way look out for nesting seabirds including herring gulls, great black-backed gulls and lesser black-backed gulls. To continue your walking in the area you could pick up the Buckie to Findochty and Cullen Coastal Walk or the Cullen to Portknockie Walk on the Moray Coast Trail .
